failures.observed: The first run passed all natural/mixed strokes and pure tilt/pinch. Its later serialized tiny-step drag incremented native boxSelections, with BOX mode false and no pan increment, taking the preserved long-press path.
failures.inference: Waiting for each renderer acknowledgement before sending tiny first movements can stretch the intended drag into a hold; no original input-event timestamps were retained, so this timing cause is an inference.
failures.resolution: Retained all six original native packets unchanged. A second ordinary Greenhaven start repeated only a short pivot, a promptly queued timestamped drag with a decisive15px first movement, menu/help, native selection and Return. The native camera panned, the box count did not rise and all follow-up checks passed.
failures.provenance: Both runs used the same exact delivery APK and four ordinary starting constructors; no world grants, production or gameplay edits.
